surface: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: illustrated game-world atlas concept, surface sheet, not a game screenshot. Primary request: draw a beautiful, clear, detailed Russian fantasy farming-adventure WORLD MAP for the game Moon Valley / Бабушкина ферма. Landscape 3:2 high-resolution composition, soft hand-painted gouache and watercolor, inviting green countryside, turquoise rivers, copper mountains, cool violet haunted east, parchment margin, delicate engraved cartography. No modern technology, trains or cars. Geographic arrangement is a proposed future world, not current implementation. Make map dominate 90% of page; small restrained compass and legend. Title exact Russian: «ЛУННАЯ ДОЛИНА». Subtitle: «ПОВЕРХНОСТЬ · ПРОТОТИП МИРА». Top-down illustrated atlas, buildings are small pictographic front-facing silhouettes rather than isometric gameplay sprites. Layout in normalized coordinates: WEST-CENTRE (18%,58%) cozy grandmother farm and home village, label «Бабушкина ферма», six tiny connected district icons around one village: shop, herb garden, orchard, guild, workyard, river crossing, NOT six distant cities. NORTHWEST (22%,18%) enormous ancient tree-root village «Подкоренье». CENTRAL FOREST (37%,38%) «Лес и башня мага», with a small old sawmill and beetle/plant encounter symbols beside optional paths. NORTH (57%,12%) copper-roofed terraced mountain village «Медный Уступ», below it at (55%,30%) label «Каменистый край», smithy and mine entrance; three wind-lightning rods on a separate northern optional plateau. SOUTHWEST (34%,77%) stilted river village «Ивовые Мостки», lanterns, reeds and a small glowing jellyfish migration on river as a seasonal EVENT, not a new permanent town. EAST-CENTRE (66%,42%) «Орочьи руины», moon castle on a nearby hill labelled «Лунный замок» with dungeon stair symbol. NORTHEAST (80%,17%) glassblower workshop «Стеклодувная». EAST (81%,40%) softly haunted violet region «Проклятая земля» and a small ruined chapel. FAR EAST (93%,53%) coast with a large old pirate sailing ship «Чёрная сельдь» and a rift at sea. SOUTHEAST (80%,79%) salty fishing village «Соляная Пристань», long common table, nets, small boat cove, optional crab shipwreck nearby. CENTRAL SOUTH (54%,64%) mobile wagon settlement «Бродячий Двор», shadow theatre canopy; show two other tiny empty camp pads connected by a light dashed migration circuit to make clear it has several stops, not three copies of the village. A river flows from copper mountains through central lowlands to Ивовые Мостки then east into the coastal bay. A renovated watermill beside that river. Mark three peaceful giant sightings as small illustrated creatures: garden turtle by Ивовые Мостки, stone deer near Подкоренье, reed-covered river giant downstream. At (65%,22%) a stone-backed ancient walking beast in a separate dry gorge, label «Русло камнехода», with rumble arcs and a few glinting fallen stones: EVENT, not boss, no railway. Place a small crescent portal near the home village, label «Портал затмения», no physical road to a moon island. Draw an intelligible looping pale road network among home, forest, copper, ruins, coast and river villages, broader caravan roads and occasional small bridge icons, several optional dead-end exploration trails. Show THREE numbered downward stair markers at home, Подкоренье and Ивовые Мостки for proposed underground shortcuts; do not draw subway tracks or underground lines on surface. Use only a few colored pictogram marks for bosses, puzzles, festivals, archaeology, caravans and stairs, each distinguished by SHAPE as well as color. Compact footer legend exact: «● Локация есть в игре   ◇ Поселение из идей   ★ Ключевое место   ↓ Подземный вход». Mark home, forest, rocky region, ruins, castle, cursed land, glassworks and ship as existing with filled dot; mark the five new settlements with hollow diamond. Bottom note exact: «Расположение и дороги предложены. Масштаб условный». Typography readable Cyrillic, enough breathing room, no illegible filler labels, no long paragraphs. Avoid claiming proposed villages or roads are implemented. Map must feel like one coherent valley opening to the sea, not disconnected square biome tiles.
underground: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: illustrated game-world atlas concept, underground sheet, not a game screenshot. Primary request: a legible high-resolution hand-painted UNDERGROUND MAP for the Russian cozy fantasy farming/adventure game Лунная долина, matching soft gouache atlas style. Landscape 3:2, parchment edge and warm charcoal rock, blue mineral light, soft violet fungi, readable Russian Cyrillic. Title exact: «ЛУННАЯ ДОЛИНА». Subtitle: «ПОДЗЕМЕЛЬЯ И КОРОТКИЕ ПУТИ · ПРОТОТИП». Top-down chamber-and-corridor cutaway, not side-on platformer. Map dominates. Main EXISTING six-room crystal cave cluster occupies the central 60%: at (25%,50%) «Вход с фермы» leads to «Кристальные пещеры» (32%,50%); connect to «Грибной зал» (44%,50%), then «Лунный грот» (56%,48%), then «Подземное озеро» (65%,65%), then «Забытое святилище» (78%,65%). «Старая шахта» (49%,29%) has TWO ordinary cave connections, one to Грибной зал and one to Подземное озеро, forming a loop. Only these SIX main chambers belong to the existing cave network. Draw these existing connections as thin continuous pale lines. At far right of sanctum, a marked stair labelled «Выход к проклятой земле»; it is a gated story exit, not a village shortcut. Add a few clearly optional dotted side chambers: «Мать Грибницы» by fungal hall; «Смотритель Вагонеток» by mine; a separate «Затопленные руины» alcove beside lake with diving bell icon; lake sleeper optional boss beyond a clearly closed side gate, not inside compulsory corridor. OUTER RING: show THREE SEPARATE proposed pedestrian shortcut tunnels, visually isolated from the main crystal cave and from one another; use warm ochre dashed corridors, NOT railways. Tunnel I in southwest along bottom-left rim links surface stair «Домашняя деревня» to «Ивовые Мостки», one boss gate label «Страж осыпи». Tunnel II across northern rim links «Подкоренье» to «Медный Уступ», one water-valve puzzle gate label «Загадка шлюза». Tunnel III along southeast bottom rim links «Ивовые Мостки» to «Соляная Пристань», one optional local gate. Each tunnel has two matching stair icons at ends, a small open-lock-after-trial symbol, and label «после открытия — навсегда». Do not connect the tunnels into a universal highway, do not connect them to the sanctum or final boss. Short label at lower margin exact: «Цель срезок: примерно ½ наземного пути. Босс или загадка — один раз». Upper-right compact SEPARATE INSET titled «ЗАМОК · АКТ II» shows «Большой зал» connected to «Верхний этаж» and separately to «Подземелье Регента»; inset has no tunnel into village shortcuts, clearly an independent interior. Beside an optional ruin branch, an eight-cell puzzle glyph labelled «Комнаты эха · 8»; not an extra required section of the main cave. Distribute a few authored trap symbols and archaeology dig marks into optional branches, do not cover the safe repeated shortcut corridor with spikes. Make safe walking floors and doors legible, coherent underground waterways, bounded glowing mushrooms, no sprawling random labyrinth. Footer legend exact: «Сплошная линия — пещера есть в игре   Пунктир — будущий проход   ⚿ Испытание   ↓ Выход на поверхность». Bottom note: «Схема не в масштабе. Новые связи требуют проверки сюжета». No modern trains, metro, engines, industrial power station, automatic claim of implementation, modern UI, photorealism or dark unreadable labels.
